about: Template for the VOC (PIDX-A-040) FACTORY sheet. When it arrives, fill every null from it and add the record to calibration_records.json with a valid_from LATER than the datasheet record, so it takes over from the datasheet typical values. Do not use any value that is not on the factory sheet. A new site zero for any gas is added the same way, as a new record with source 'site_zero' and the factory-sheet sensitivity (see CAL-H2S-SITE-0001 and CAL-NH3-SITE-0001). Optional temperature fields (H2S only): we_electronic_mv, ae_electronic_mv and gain_mv_per_na from the ISB sheet, and temp_algorithm (AAN 803-05 1-4).

records.notes: From the PID factory sheet: zero (mV) goes in we_zero_mv; sensitivity (mV/ppm).
